gaps.gap: The metrics and their provenance are implemented and proven at the service and endpoint layers, but two links in the chain have never actually executed. (1) The Gherkin step 'And I should see "Target attainment"' in tests/features/basic-analytics-dashboard.feature is the only executable proof that the provenance line RENDERS, and no scenario in this project has ever been run by the Playwright/BDD runner - the Test MCP container has no LeadFlow workspace mount, so tests/features is unreachable to it. This task did fix a defect that would have made that run meaningless: the file's Background block was parsed before any Scenario and never executed, so all three scenarios ran signed out; they now carry @login:default. (2) The delivered-from-sdk-sla branch of AnalyticsService.askAttainment has never spoken to a real gateway - PROJEXCLOUD_GATEWAY_URL is unset in every environment here, so the endpoint always answers with attainment.delivered:false and the locally-counted figures. The branch is proven only against a stub at the SdkGatewayClient boundary. The same environment limitation is already recorded against the ProjexCloud linkage criterion on Lead Capture. (3) By deliberate choice the api_definition's happy-path testCase does not assert the attainment or clock_provenance blocks: their values follow from whether a gateway is configured rather than from request input, so pinning delivered:false would document this environment rather than the contract and would fail the moment a gateway exists.
